title: The Open Fund for Music Creators

The deadlines page also notes 'We will be operating 2 x Open Fund for Music Creators deadlines in 2026' (the earlier round opened 25 February and closed 18 March 2026). Scheme page carries only 'Check deadlines before applying', so the date evidence is the deadlines table.

The scheme page states 'PRS Foundation are currently managing deadlines in July and September 2026'; the funder's own All Upcoming Deadlines table (site/prsfoundation.com/funding-support/deadlines/index.html) lists rolling rounds 16-20 and the round live at 2026-08-28 is Round 17, closing 3 September 2026. The four dates recorded are that deadline plus the three later rounds the table publishes (29 October 2026, 10 December 2026, 4 February 2027), hence multi_deadline. The scheme page carries an active 'Apply now' link and its guidance page states 'we are running 1 Deadline per year in the autumn for the following annual season', which points to a round opening after the 2026-08-28 snapshot; but Resonate does NOT appear in the funder's own All Upcoming Deadlines table (site/prsfoundation.com/funding-support/deadlines/index.html), which the funder presents as covering 'all upcoming opportunities'.
